fusions.name: Seed Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a seed that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 40% of the damage the poison deals. The seed knocks the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Bramble Fence
fusions.desc: Raises a line of briars 3 tiles long for 5 seconds that deals 6 damage to each enemy crossing it. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Shade Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Roots Down
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal 8% of your maximum health per stack (32% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
